name: Pull Cord
description: A switch you pull: an elastic cord with a glass bead that clicks past a threshold, springs back and swings to rest.

props.name: pulled
props.description: Whether it is on, when controlled.

props.name: defaultPulled
props.description: Whether it starts on, when uncontrolled.

props.name: onPull
props.description: Called with the new state each time the cord clicks past its threshold, or is pressed with Space or Enter.

props.name: length
props.description: Resting length of the cord in pixels. The pull needed to click is about a third of it, and the component is tall enough to hold the bead at full stretch.

props.name: label
props.description: The accessible name of the switch.

props.name: sound
props.description: Plays a short, quiet synthesised click when it switches.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes on the root. Other div props are passed through.
